wheat.definition: Any of the several cereal grains, of the genus Triticum, that yields flour as used in bakery.

wheel.definition: A circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines.

wheels.definition: Form of wheel (plural): A circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

whence.definition: From where; from which place or source.

whenever.definition: When ever: emphatic form of when.

where.definition: In, at or to what place.

whereby.definition: By what, in which direction; how.

wherefore.definition: An intent or purpose; a why.

wherever.definition: Where ever; an emphatic form of where.

while.definition: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

whilst.definition: Often preceded by the: During the time; meanwhile.

whims.definition: Form of whim (plural): A fanciful impulse, or sudden change of idea.

whirlwind.definition: A windstorm of limited extent, such as a tornado, dust devil, or waterspout, characterized by an inward spiral motion of the air with an upward current in the center; a vortex of air.

whispers.definition: Form of whisper (plural): The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

whit.definition: The smallest part or particle imaginable; an iota.

white.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

wholly.definition: Completely and entirely; to the fullest extent.

why.definition: Form of wye (alternative): The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wicked.definition: Evil or mischievous by nature; morally reprehensible.

wickedness.definition: The state of being wicked; evil disposition; immorality.

widest.definition: Form of wide (superlative): Having a large physical extent from side to side.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wilder.definition: Form of wild (comparative): Untamed; not domesticated.

wilderness.definition: Uncultivated and unsettled land in its natural state inhabited by wild animals and with vegetation growing wild; (countable) a tract of such land; a waste or wild.

wildness.definition: The state or quality of being wild.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willing.definition: Form of will (gerund participle present): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willows.definition: Form of willow (plural): Any of various deciduous trees or shrubs in the genus Salix, in the willow family Salicaceae, found primarily on moist soils in cooler zones in the northern hemisphere.

wills.definition: Form of will (indicative present singular third-person): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wilt.definition: Form of will (archaic indicative present second-person singular): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

winder.definition: Form of window (pronunciation-spelling): An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

winding.definition: Form of wind (gerund participle present): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wings.definition: Form of wing (plural): An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

winter.definition: Traditionally the fourth of the four seasons, typically regarded as spanning either the period between the winter solstice to the spring equinox, or the months of December, January, and February in temperate and polar re.

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wisely.definition: In a wise manner; using good judgement.

wiser.definition: Form of wise (comparative): Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wishes.definition: Form of wish (indicative present singular third-person): To desire; to want.

wisp.definition: A small bundle, as of straw or other like substance; a twisted handful of something; any slender, flexible structure or group.

witch.definition: A person (now usually particularly a woman) who uses magical or similar supernatural powers to influence or predict events, particularly one with malicious motives.

witches.definition: Form of witch (plural): A person (now usually particularly a woman) who uses magical or similar supernatural powers to influence or predict events, particularly one with malicious motives.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withdrawing.definition: Form of withdraw (gerund participle present): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdrew.definition: Form of withdraw (past): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

wither.definition: To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

withholding.definition: The deduction of taxes from an employee's salary.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnesses.definition: Form of witness (plural): Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

wives.definition: Form of wife (plural): A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wizards.definition: Form of wizard (plural): Someone, usually male, who uses (or has skill with) magic, mystic items, and magical and mystical practices.

womb.definition: In female mammals, the organ in which the young are conceived and grow until birth; the uterus.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

women-children.definition: Form of womanchild (plural): An immature woman.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

wondering.definition: Form of wonder (gerund participle present): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonders.definition: Form of wonder (plural): A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wore.definition: Form of wear (past): To have on.

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workmanship.definition: The skill of an artisan or craftsman.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world-makers.definition: Form of worldmaker (plural): The creator of a world.

world-making.definition: The creation of a world, as for example in writing fiction.

worldly.definition: Concerned with human or earthly matters, physical as opposed to spiritual.

worlds.definition: Form of world (plural): The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worm.definition: A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worn-out.definition: Damaged due to continued or hard exposure or use until no longer effective or useful.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worship.definition: To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

worshipped.definition: Form of worship (UK participle past): To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wounds.definition: Form of wound (plural): An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.

wrangle.definition: To convince or influence (someone) by arguing or contending.

wrangled.definition: Form of wrangle (participle past): To convince or influence (someone) by arguing or contending.

wrapped.definition: Form of wrap (participle past): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wreck.definition: Something or someone that has been ruined.

wrestles.definition: Form of wrestle (indicative present singular third-person): To take part in (a wrestling bout or match).

wretch.definition: An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

wrinkled.definition: Form of wrinkle (participle past): To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writings.definition: Form of writing (plural): Graphism of symbols such as letters that express some meaning.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zealot.definition: One who is zealous, one who is full of zeal for their own specific beliefs or objectives, usually in the negative sense of being too passionate; a fanatic.
